brief: The mayor, and the player. Each cell is 16 wide by 32 tall, two tiles, Stardew proportions: head about a third of the height, top three rows kept clear so a hat fits later. Row order down, up, left, right. Frame order idle, step left, idle, step right. A sash or a chain of office, otherwise plain. Feet land on the anchor in every frame or the character bobs.
sketchNote: One cell, facing down, idle, 16 wide by 32 tall. The sheet is 4 rows (down, up, left, right) x 4 frames (idle, step left, idle, step right), so 64x128. Rows 0 to 2 stay empty for a hat. Head rows 3 to 13, coat 14 to 23 with the = sash running shoulder to hip, trousers 24 to 28, shoes 29 to 31. Feet sit on the last row in every frame.
